JR 02

Step-free guide

Platforms2–13

ElevatorエレベーターSix lifts, one per platform

There are six separate lifts, one for each platform group — not one lift shared across the whole station.

APlatform 2
Tokaido Line, for Toyohashi. Up escalator only — the down escalator is on platform 3.
BPlatforms 3–4
Tokaido Line, both directions. Up and down escalators.
CPlatforms 5–6
Tokaido Line, for Gifu. Up and down escalators.
DPlatforms 7–8
Chuo Line. Up and down escalators.
EPlatforms 10–11
Chuo Line & Kansai Line. Up and down escalators.
FPlatforms 12–13
Kansai Line. No escalator at all — that lift, or stairs, is the only way up. Allow extra time.

Accessible toilet車椅子トイレThree locations

JR Central lists wheelchair-accessible toilets in three places at this station — not just one. All three have a baby seat and an ostomate fitting.

AInside the JR local-line gates
Wheelchair-accessible, baby seat, ostomate fitting.
BInside the Shinkansen gates
Same three fittings — only reachable if you are already through the Shinkansen barrier. Full detail on the Shinkansen page.
COutside all the gates
Same three fittings. No ticket or gate needed.
Exact position
Not published in text for any of the three. Illustrated once we have walked it.
Nearby
Lost & Found (忘れ物承り所) is on the North Passage.

Entrances & exits出入口Sakuradori side

The main gates are on the 桜通口 · Sakuradori side, facing the city. The concourse is three parallel passages running west: North, Central and South.

Main gates
Central Gate (中央口) and Central North Gate (中央北口), opening onto those passages.
For Meitetsu & Kintetsu
広小路口 · Hirokoji Exit, at the north-east corner, is the nearest.
For the Aonami Line
太閤通南口 · Taikodori South, at the far west end.
Meeting someone
The Gold Clock stands on the Sakuradori side — the best-known meeting point in the station.
Ask here
Nagoya Tourist Information is in the Central Concourse at the Sakuradori end.
Coin lockers
Multiple locations, including the Central Concourse and near the Hirokoji exit; staffed luggage counters at Sakuradori and Taikodori exits.

Platformsのりば2 to 13

The numbers run from the Sakuradori end westwards. Platforms 1–4 are nearest Sakuradori; 12–13 and the Shinkansen at 14–17 are at the Taikodori end.

Rule of thumb
A higher platform number means a longer walk west.
There is no platform 1
Out of use since October 2019 because of construction. The numbering starts at 2.
